Dialogues 1-1..1-4 + language notes inspected: formal introductions 'It's nice to meet you' → 'Pleasure to meet you, too'; informal 'Nice to meet you' → 'You, too'; notes explicitly state 'Good night' is not a greeting (used when leaving) and that 'Nice to meet you' is the first-meeting formula. Role in SE Lesson 001: ADAPTED — supplies the response pattern for 'Nice to meet you too.' (composition disclosed in stage map) and the verbatim 'Good night.' distractor.
